AE-08 phase 8 bless blockers 1 and 2 (PARENT-RULING-P8-BLESS-BLOCKERS.md; hand record, no --bless, expectations.json unchanged). Covers two things.

(1) The controller class table named `greenAfter: "P8"` for the resume-structure prefix (711f1041, phase 8 step 11a), and `P8` was not in gateSteps, so the gate's schema parse threw after all 100 seeds and gate.json was never written (jobs campaign:trace-controller-a and -b, trace:controller). gateSteps A1..B6 are the phase 5 steps, in the order a class turns green; step 11a came after B6. Fix: ae-08-processor-state-fuzz-classes.ts appends `P8-11a` after B6 (with its meaning) and the prefix names it. The campaigns still run `--gate B6`, which does not require P8-11a classes green; resume-structure still fails the gate on any failure whose class the table does not list. Red: --only campaign:trace-controller-a fails 'gate.json was not written'. Green: --only campaign:trace-controller-a,campaign:trace-controller-b PASS and each writes gate.json (step B6, no violation).

(2) The hook B6 gate prefix intent-aba (harness-error 'Unreachable intent-aba witness dependency' plus I1 stale-intent-published), first bad commit fb679615 (record 34 era, phase 8 step 11d A). It is a product defect, not an oracle issue. fb679615 removed the effect that submitted every edit to the controller while playing; the follow (followPortableEdits) now submits only when the desired fingerprint differs from previewProjectionBaseline, which advances when an adoption settles. An edit B in flight, then an edit back to the adopted A, found desired == baseline and submitted nothing, so B's compile was never superseded and published: native held B while the project was A (the latest edit must win). Trace (seed 1, scenario intent-aba, HEAD): step 88 clip-timing 0.5 starts compile 38; step 89 clip-timing 0.25 submits nothing; steps 90-128 prepare and callback-publication of revision 4 (witness aba-final: compiles 1, publishes 1, starts [24000], expected publishes 0 and starts 12000); the second phase's edit to 0.5 then finds 0.5 already adopted, starts no compile, and the `until` throws. Fix: useTimelinePlayback.ts keeps nativeAdoptionKey (the key of the newest native adoption not yet settled) and followPortableEdits skips only when desired == baseline and nativeAdoptionKey is unset or equal to desired. Witness: useTimelinePlayback.test.ts 'UD7n W-S11d-A4 an edit back to the adopted state while the previous edit compiles keeps that edit from publishing' (the harness withNativeTransportEdit gains a compile hold and a publishes list). Red first: with the fix absent it fails (adoptions 1 and publishes 1, expected 0 and 0); fixed it passes. Fuzz: --scenario intent-aba fails at HEAD and at fb679615 and passes at 4538a44d and with the fix (aba-final: compiles 2, publishes 0, starts [12000]; aba-waiting: compiles 1, publishes 1, starts [24000]). Hook seeds 1-300 pass, controller seeds 1-300 pass, hook B6 gate with --trace all over seeds 1-100: gate pass, 0 violations, 4459 files (the count recorded at 4538a44d). FAST-CERT --only campaign:trace-hook-a and -b: intent-aba passes, no gate violation; they still fail on seed 18 compileCount 12 above the recorded 11 (f67cfdf6), which the seed re-record at --full covers.

Checks on the tree: C 685 pass, 1 skip; HT 258 pass, 1 skip, 2 fail (the 2 known reds, untouched); portable-browser-playback-controller 157 pass; native-schedule-coordinator 67 pass; native-vst3-coordinator 49 pass; native-playback-lifecycle.browser 5 pass; bun run typecheck exit 0; bun tools/typecheck.ts no new errors (101 known); oxlint 17 warnings, 5 errors (baseline). FAST-CERT --only: 164 ledger arms and 165 c0 and diag arms for the rows the changed files select pass; the 15 HT gates (x-matrix, x-probe160, f-playback, f-hookwit, f-b6family, rc1-g-playback and the rest) pass. Pinned hashes of the changed files are left for --full.
